Introduction

Shin Jaemin, or simply Jaemin, is a South Korean singer. He is best known for being a member of the boy group XD (formerly XEED).

Prior to debuting, Jaemin appeared on Mnet’s 2016 survival show BOYS24 where he made it to the semi-finals. He later worked as a backup dancer for different groups and idols before finally debuting in XD in 2022.
